description: Manage Vectera meeting rooms, settings, permissions, and join links.

auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Vectera API token sent as Authorization: Token <token>. Request a token from Vectera support, then view it at the bottom of your profile: https://www.vectera.com/profile/.

actions.name: create_meeting_room
actions.description: Create a Vectera meeting room with optional ownership and access settings.

key.description: A unique identifier to use in the meeting room URL.

ownerId.description: The Vectera user id that owns the meeting room.

publicAccessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

teamAccessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

preferredKey.description: A preferred meeting room key that Vectera may suffix to avoid conflicts.

templateId.description: The Vectera meeting room template id to apply.

items.description: A related meeting room field to include.

include.description: Optional related fields to include in each Vectera meeting room response.

inputSchema.description: Fields for creating a Vectera meeting room.

key.description: The identifier used in the meeting room URL.

url.description: The public URL used to join the meeting room.

ownerId.description: The id of the meeting room owner.

publicAccessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

teamAccessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

dateCreated.description: When the meeting room was created.

isOpened.description: Whether at least one participant is currently in the meeting room.

isActive.description: Whether the meeting room currently has an active multi-participant session.

meetingRoom.description: A Vectera meeting room returned by the API.

outputSchema.description: The created Vectera meeting room response.

actions.name: create_meeting_room_permission
actions.description: Create a shareable Vectera meeting room access permission and join URL.

meetingRoomId.description: The Vectera meeting room id to grant access to.

accessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

email.description: An email address that should receive the meeting room invitation.

userId.description: A Vectera user id that should receive the invitation.

inviteMessage.description: The optional message included with an emailed invitation.

inputSchema.description: Fields for creating a Vectera meeting room permission.

id.description: The Vectera meeting room permission id.

meetingRoomId.description: The id of the meeting room this permission grants access to.

accessKey.description: The secure access key generated for this permission.

url.description: The URL used to join the meeting room with this permission.

accessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

permission.description: A Vectera meeting room permission returned by the API.

outputSchema.description: The created Vectera meeting room permission response.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Get the user associated with the connected Vectera API token.

items.description: A related current-user field to include.

include.description: Optional related fields to include in the current Vectera user response.

inputSchema.description: Options for retrieving the current Vectera user.

anyOf.description: The username within the Vectera organization.

username.description: The username within the Vectera organization.

organizationId.description: The id of the user's Vectera organization.

user.description: The current Vectera user returned by the API.

actions.name: get_meeting_room
actions.description: Get one Vectera meeting room by id.

items.description: A related meeting room field to include.

include.description: Optional related fields to include in each Vectera meeting room response.

inputSchema.description: Input for retrieving one Vectera meeting room.

key.description: The identifier used in the meeting room URL.

url.description: The public URL used to join the meeting room.

ownerId.description: The id of the meeting room owner.

publicAccessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

teamAccessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

dateCreated.description: When the meeting room was created.

isOpened.description: Whether at least one participant is currently in the meeting room.

isActive.description: Whether the meeting room currently has an active multi-participant session.

meetingRoom.description: A Vectera meeting room returned by the API.

actions.name: get_meeting_room_settings
actions.description: Get settings for one Vectera meeting room.

inputSchema.description: Input identifying one Vectera meeting room.

showPrivateNotes.description: Whether private note controls are visible to the meeting room host.

presenterMode.description: Whether presenter mode is active in the meeting room.

forwardUrl.description: The URL guests are sent to after the meeting ends.

outputSchema.description: The Vectera meeting room settings response.

actions.name: list_meeting_rooms
actions.description: List Vectera meeting rooms available to the connected user.

perPage.description: The number of meeting rooms to return per page.

search.description: Text to search for in meeting room keys.

filter.description: A Vectera filter expression for meeting room fields.

items.description: One Vectera meeting room sort field.

orderBy.description: Meeting room fields to sort by; prefix a field with - for descending order.

items.description: A related meeting room field to include.

include.description: Optional related fields to include in each Vectera meeting room response.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination controls for listing Vectera meeting rooms.

key.description: The identifier used in the meeting room URL.

url.description: The public URL used to join the meeting room.

teamAccessLevel.description: The access level granted for a Vectera meeting room.

dateCreated.description: When the meeting room was created.

isOpened.description: Whether at least one participant is currently in the meeting room.

isActive.description: Whether the meeting room currently has an active multi-participant session.

items.description: A Vectera meeting room returned by the API.

meetingRooms.description: The meeting rooms returned for this page.

anyOf.description: The URL of the next page, or null when there is no next page.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null when there is no next page.

anyOf.description: The URL of the previous page, or null when there is no previous page.

previous.description: The URL of the previous page, or null when there is no previous page.

first.description: The URL of the first page, or null when it is not returned.

anyOf.description: The URL of the last page, or null when it is not returned.

last.description: The URL of the last page, or null when it is not returned.

pagination.description: Pagination links parsed from the Vectera Link header.

outputSchema.description: A page of Vectera meeting rooms.
